cipher.name: ReverseWordOrderCipher
cipher.idea: Keep all individual words spelled normally so the model can read and reason over them perfectly, but reverse the order of the words in the sentence. Punctuation marks are treated as separate words to maintain structural integrity.
cipher.encrypt_rules: 1. Split the input text into tokens (words and punctuation marks are treated as separate tokens; spaces are used as delimiters but collapsed). 2. Reverse the sequence of these tokens. 3. Join the reversed tokens with a single space.
cipher.decrypt_rules: 1. Split the encrypted text by spaces into tokens. 2. Reverse the sequence of these tokens back to their original order. 3. Join the tokens back into a coherent sentence.

example.plaintext: This is a very simple test.
example.ciphertext: . test simple very a is This
